title: Quantum gravity pushed as the holy grail from 1984 to 1987

tellings.quote: and quantum gravity was just thrust down everybody's throat as the holy grail from 1984 to87 and by the time of ' 87 everybody had accepted this.

plain: From 1984 to 1987, quantum gravity, the effort to merge Einstein's theory of gravity with quantum physics, was 'thrust down everybody's throat' as the holy grail of theoretical physics, and by 1987 everyone had accepted it. The mathematician Eric Weinstein tells Michels this as his own account, without a source. He offers it as an example of physics being steered toward one goal.
